compliance.control: Data minimisation / privacy by design - secrets and personal data are masked inside the read tool, before any LLM call, log or report
Purpose limitation and lawful basis - only synthetic test data (fake secrets and emails generated by tools/make_kit.py) is processed
compliance.detail: manual: data/golden/MANIFEST.json; tools/make_kit.py (CANARY values are fake)

compliance.control: Storage limitation - run outputs and the LLM cache stay local in backend/runs/ (git-ignored) and are deleted after 30 days
Right to erasure - every stored item is under backend/runs/<run_id>/ or runs/.llm_cache/ and can be deleted per run; prompts sent to providers contain masked data only
Logical access - role-based access to restricted files enforced by Casbin after path normalisation
Secrets protection - API keys only in backend/.env (git-ignored), never in tracked files, logs or reports
compliance.detail: .env ignored=True, tracked files with key patterns=[]

compliance.control: Monitoring - every tool call is in a hash-chained audit log with role, tool, target and decision
Change management - prompt-template hash, model id, golden-dataset hash and dependency-lock hashes recorded with each run
compliance.detail: 311 entries carry dataset/deps hashes; prompt hashes {'vA': 'b2407cfbc52b', 'vB': '7beb13ba909d', 'v0': '70b9bc9216ef'}

compliance.control: Processing location - LLM calls go to Google Gemini API and Groq (both may process outside Singapore). Accepted because only masked, synthetic code leaves the machine; real customer code would need a regional endpoint first
Data at rest - golden dataset, runs, logs and keys are stored only on the local workstation; nothing is pushed to a remote
